name: generated-project
on: [push, pull_request]
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '24'
      - run: npm test

# {{name}}

A deterministic Dynamo project. Run `npm test`. Source is generated without executing hooks or downloading code. Review before deployment.

export const greet = name => `Hello ${name}`;
if (process.argv[1] === new URL(import.meta.url).pathname) console.log(greet(process.argv[2] || "world"));
import test from "node:test"; import assert from "node:assert/strict"; import {greet} from "./src.mjs"; test("greeting",()=>assert.equal(greet("world"),"Hello world"));
